title: UK Stewardship Code streamlined reports but ‘real test’ ahead
lede: Investors say latest iteration has reduced reporting burdens and allowed for more meaningful and outcomes-focused disclosures.

title: EU gives oil and gas importers until 2029 on methane checks, rules out more delay
lede: After all-night talks, EU governments and MEPs agreed to delay methane regulations until 2029, but scrapped the legal possibility for further fob-offs, in a win for centre-left politics.
